components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confident action control for search, computation, and other primary operations.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:var(--radius-md,10px); background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--uml-blue,#1257D1),var(--uml-dark-blue,#00396E)); color:#fff; font:600 .85rem/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .15s ease,transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(18,87,209,.35); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:.72; transform:none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that remains visible without competing with the primary control.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.5rem 1rem; border:1px solid rgba(90,219,255,.34); border-radius:var(--radius-md,10px); background:rgba(0,57,110,.5); color:#F7FBFF; font:600 .85rem/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,transform .15s ease; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color:#B8C7D5; background:rgba(18,87,209,.28); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:#00B5F1; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,181,241,.25); } .ds-button-outline:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Instrument Input
components.description: A recessed entry well for locations, API keys, and advanced numeric values.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.4rem; color:#B8C7D5; font:600 .825rem/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width:100%; padding:.55rem .75rem; border:1px solid rgba(90,219,255,.34); border-radius:var(--radius-md,10px); outline:none; background:#071A2B; color:#F7FBFF; font:400 .875rem/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; transition:border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color:#1257D1; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(18,87,209,.35); } .ds-field input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Simulator Navigation
components.description: A compact mode switch that keeps the active workspace unmistakable.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:inline-flex; gap:.5rem; padding:.25rem; border:1px solid rgba(90,219,255,.16); border-radius:var(--radius-md,10px); background:rgba(0,57,110,.34); } .ds-nav button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:.45rem 1rem; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-sm,6px); background:transparent; color:#B8C7D5; font:600 .875rem/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-nav button:hover { background:rgba(90,219,255,.09); color:#F7FBFF; } .ds-nav button[aria-current=page] { background:#1257D1; color:#fff; box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(18,87,209,.35); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,181,241,.35); }

components.name: Instrument Card
components.description: The standard layered enclosure for controls, charts, and detailed data.
components.html:
Monthly AC energy output

Calculated with official PVWatts v8 and current NSRDB data.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width:28rem; padding:1.25rem; border:1px solid rgba(90,219,255,.16); border-radius:var(--radius-lg,16px); background:rgba(0,57,110,.3); color:#F7FBFF; box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.2); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); transition:border-color .2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:rgba(90,219,255,.42); } .ds-card h3 { margin:0 0 .65rem; font:700 1.05rem/1.35 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-card p { margin:0; color:#B8C7D5; font:400 .875rem/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color:#00B5F1; box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.3),0 0 0 2px rgba(0,181,241,.2); }

components.name: KPI Readout
components.description: A calibrated headline result with a semantic energy rail and attached unit.
components.html: Annual AC energy5,240 kWhEstimated annual production
components.css: .ds-kpi { position:relative; overflow:hidden; min-width:14rem; padding:1.15rem; border:1px solid rgba(90,219,255,.16); border-radius:var(--radius-lg,16px); background:rgba(0,57,110,.3); color:#F7FBFF; } .ds-kpi::before { position:absolute; inset:0 0 auto; height:3px; background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FFD140,#00B5F1); content:""; } .ds-kpi-label,.ds-kpi-note { display:block; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-kpi-label { margin-bottom:.35rem; color:#B8C7D5; font-size:.775rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-kpi strong { display:block; font:800 1.85rem/1.1 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Monaco,Consolas,monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-kpi strong small { margin-left:.25rem; color:#878A8F; font-size:.85rem; } .ds-kpi-note { margin-top:.35rem; color:#3BD5AE; font-size:.75rem; } .ds-kpi:focus-within { border-color:#00B5F1; }

components.name: Solar Value Badge
components.description: A compact measured-value marker tied specifically to solar and energy controls.
components.css: .ds-solar-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:.15rem .5rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,209,64,.25); border-radius:var(--radius-sm,6px); background:rgba(255,209,64,.1); color:#FFD140; font:700 .825rem/1.4 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Monaco,Consolas,monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-solar-badge:hover { border-color:rgba(255,209,64,.5); background:rgba(255,209,64,.15); } .ds-solar-badge:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,209,64,.18); }

components.name: Calculation Status
components.description: A live model-state readout whose semantic color distinguishes information, success, and failure.
components.html: Official PVWatts v8 · NSRDB grid 47.50, −122.20
components.css: .ds-status { min-height:2.25rem; padding:.55rem .8rem; border:1px solid rgba(0,181,241,.38); border-radius:var(--radius-md,10px); background:rgba(0,181,241,.09); color:#5ADBFF; font:400 .8rem/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-status[data-state=success] { border-color:rgba(59,213,174,.4); background:rgba(59,213,174,.09); color:#3BD5AE; } .ds-status[data-state=error] { border-color:rgba(251,71,31,.55); background:rgba(158,49,36,.22); color:#FB471F; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,181,241,.25); }

components.name: Compass Readout
components.description: A signature physical metaphor that links azimuth input to an immediately readable orientation.
components.css: .ds-compass { display:inline-flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:.35rem; margin:0; padding:.75rem 1rem; border:1px solid rgba(90,219,255,.16); border-radius:var(--radius-md,10px); background:rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-compass figcaption { color:#878A8F; font:600 .725rem/1.2 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Segoe UI,Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-compass-face { position:relative; display:grid; width:64px; height:64px; place-items:center; border:2px dashed rgba(90,219,255,.34); border-radius:50%; background:#001C36; } .ds-compass-face::before { position:absolute; bottom:50%; width:3px; height:26px; border-radius:2px; background:linear-gradient(to top,#00B5F1,#FFD140); box-shadow:0 0 6px #FFD140; content:""; transform:rotate(180deg); transform-origin:bottom center; } .ds-compass-face span { z-index:1; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#F7FBFF; } .ds-compass output { color:#FFD140; font:700 .75rem/1.2 ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Monaco,Consolas,monospace; }

narrative.overview:
PVWatts Studio should feel like calibrated solar test equipment translated into a teaching workspace. The black and deep-blue canvas recedes while structured panel layers, cyan instrument lines, yellow energy readouts, and green validation signals make the model's state immediately visible. The system is technical because the work is technical, but every label, unit, grouping, and state should help a first-time student orient rather than make expertise a prerequisite.

The chosen character is **layered and calibrated**: tonal depth and precise borders establish hierarchy before any glow appears. Translucency, blur, shadow, and illumination are functional instrument effects—not atmosphere applied indiscriminately. The UMass Lowell-derived palette is a binding visual identity, but the interface does not need to name the institution and must never use the palette to imply affiliation or endorsement.
keyCharacteristics: Deep black and navy operating canvas with calibrated blue surface layers.
Solar yellow reserved for energy, measured emphasis, and physical control feedback.
Cyan and brand blue carry navigation, information, focus, and actionable state.
Compact sans-serif interface language paired with monospaced measured values.
Dense but strongly grouped layouts that remain precise, never intimidating.
Restrained ambient depth with selective signal glow.

rules.name: The Energy Has a Color Rule
rules.body: Solar yellow belongs to energy output, measured emphasis, and direct manipulation feedback; it is not a generic decorative accent.

rules.name: The Signal Semantics Rule
rules.body: Blue and cyan mean interaction or information, green means valid or complete, and orange means error or recovery. Never swap these roles for visual variety.

rules.name: The Full-Palette Exception Rule
rules.body: Use the extended fern, river, gold, and maroon accents together only in parametric comparison views where series distinction is functional.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Sans-serif explains and directs; monospace measures and compares.

rules.name: The No Faux Terminal Rule
rules.body: Do not use monospace for prose, navigation, or headings merely to make the interface feel technical.

rules.name: The Units Stay Attached Rule
rules.body: Keep units visually subordinate but adjacent to their values, and never rely on position alone to explain a measurement.

rules.name: The Control-to-Result Rule
rules.body: Inputs and their consequences must remain in the same working context; do not hide primary results behind a separate route or modal.

rules.name: The Group Before Space Rule
rules.body: Use proximity to bind labels, values, and controls, then use the larger section rhythm to separate tasks. Do not make every gap equal.

rules.name: The Structure Before Glow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with tone, border, and offset shadow first. Add glow only when it communicates active, focused, solar, or successful state.

rules.name: The One Raised Plane Rule
rules.body: Reserve the strongest shadow for overlays and temporary feedback; ordinary cards share one quieter elevation plane.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner controls must use a smaller radius than the surface containing them, preserving the sense of assembled instrumentation.

dos: **Do** preserve the UMass Lowell-derived palette while keeping institutional naming optional and non-affiliation explicit.
**Do** use Solar Charge to connect energy controls, charts, and calculated AC output.
**Do** make every measurement's label, value, and unit understandable without relying on color alone.
**Do** build hierarchy with tonal layering and cyan-tinted borders before adding shadow or glow.
**Do** keep technical density approachable through strong grouping, plain labels, progressive disclosure, and visible system status.
**Do** use the extended accent family when a parametric comparison genuinely needs multiple distinguishable series.
donts: **Don't** imply that the palette or interface represents sponsorship, endorsement, or an official NLR, NREL, Department of Energy, PVWatts, or UMass Lowell product.
**Don't** use Solar Charge, Valid Green, or Fault Orange interchangeably; each has a fixed semantic job.
**Don't** spread glow, blur, or translucency across every surface; instrument effects must explain depth or state.
**Don't** use monospace as a technical costume for prose, navigation, or general headings.
**Don't** extend the logo's legacy white-to-blue text gradient into headings, KPIs, or body copy.
**Don't** display the full accent family outside analytical comparison contexts.
